items.verdict: all non-magical variants; no effect and no easter eggs, so pure Gale food
DARK URGE ORIGIN ONLY; free invisibility on a kill, broken, and the only act one magic cloak
free Fog Cloud on disengage; huge ceiling for rogues and crime, but needs player patience
reaction halves one elemental hit and adds 1d6 to a weapon attack; a decent panic button
+1 AC and +1 saving throws permanently; ONLY ONE EXISTS and someone wears it all game
1d4 heal on poisoning; needs Broodmother's Revenge and Poisoner's Gloves for a weak three-slot combo
1d4 acid on melee hits taken; ON TACTICIAN OR BELOW bugged damage riders make it far stronger
needs a reverberation build and a fixed DC13 Constitution save; will practically never trigger
8 temporary HP when casting in melee; next best caster cloak after the Cloak of Protection
burning on a trivial DC12 Dexterity save; a strictly worse Fleshmelter Cloak
disadvantage on attacks against you every turn until hit; also steers enemy AI away
+1 spell save DC and spell attack plus elemental absorption; best in slot for casters
free Crusader's Mantle per short rest; scales hard with summons and multiattackers
Dominate Person once per long rest, but uses item save DC so mono-class casters only
permanent wet; vulnerability outweighs resistance except in the Pyroquickness Hat sorcerer combo
lower crit threshold while hiding; excellent for stealth archers and crit builds
in-combat-only wet, so a worse Reverse Rain Cloak; equip it for the joke
